additional_info.subject: ID0423462-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R9 170002770 ] charging point is not available CRM:02684000221
additional_info.body:
Hello Eduard, good afternoon.
We acknowledge the error. This charger is in an outdated version, would updating the charger be an option for you?
This is because with newer versions we have better logging and have remote access to the charger's devices, and be able to troubleshoot and give a solution sooner.
I have requested remote access in case we are not allowed to update the charger.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
